concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: single icon-only filled prism logo exploration for kollens, a crypto KOL and wallet tracking platform whose name evokes a lens.
Primary request: An original LENS PRISM mark: a strong solid clipped diamond or hexagonal prism body containing one generous diagonal almond-shaped optical void. Crisp planar facets and controlled small corner fillets. Its visual meaning is reading signals through a lens. An asymmetric faceted outer cut gives it distinctive personality, with an optically balanced silhouette.
Style/medium: precise flat vector-like fintech brand icon. Exact flat gold #F9C932 on plain solid charcoal #101113.
Composition: one bold icon only, centered around 60% of square canvas width with generous margins. Few facets, generous gold mass, strong clear optical void, highly recognizable at 24px.
Constraints: no text, letters, wordmark, K monogram, arrow, eye illustration, camera, nodes, tiny dots, 3D shading, cube, light illustration, gradients, lighting, texture, grain, glow, shadows, mockups or frames. One clean flat gold silhouette with one diagonal optical opening.

Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: single icon-only filled prism logo exploration for kollens, a crypto KOL and wallet tracking platform whose name evokes optical focus.
Primary request: An original REFRACTED FOCUS mark: a compact solid triangular or diamond prism body with one clean negative-space light-beam cut entering from one side and splitting into two short refracted cuts exiting in opposite directions. Optical refraction symbolizes tracking multiple on-chain signals. Use a single bold connected gold silhouette with just a few generous clean cuts and ample solid gold mass.
Style/medium: precise flat vector-like fintech brand icon, strong geometric construction and controlled crisp corners. Exact flat gold #F9C932 on plain solid charcoal #101113.
Composition: one icon only, centered around 60% of a square canvas width, generous margins, clear simple negative-space cut, highly recognizable at 24px.
Constraints: avoid A, K and Y monograms, all letters and text, arrows, nodes, tiny dots, literal eye or camera, 3D shading, cube or light illustration. No gradients, lighting, texture, grain, glow, shadows, mockups or frames. The cut must appear as optical refraction inside a compact filled prism, with no separate lines outside the mark.
